newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK, Netherlands reach agreement on airline tax.
newsitem.headline: HK, Netherlands reach agreement on airline tax.

text.p: Hong Kong has reached an agreement with the Netherlands on arrangements to provide double taxation relief for airline income, the government said on Wednesday.
"Amendments have been made to the Air Services Agreement of Hong Kong with the Netherlands to incorporate the relief arrangements," a government spokeman said.
The measures will be tabled in the Legislative Council, Hong Kong's lawmaking chamber, on February 19, he added.
Under the arrangements, Hong Kong will tax the income of Hong Kong airlines derived from the Netherlands which has been granted full tax relief by the Netherlands.
In return, Hong Kong will forgo the right to tax the income of Dutch airlines derived from Hong Kong if it is subject to tax in the Netherlands.
